# exo_dnssec_verified_domain (Resource)

Enables DNSSEC for a verified domain (Enable-DnssecForVerifiedDomain); destroying the resource runs Disable-DnssecForVerifiedDomain. The toggle has no boolean read-back, so out-of-band disabling is not detected as drift; the status attribute exposes the raw Get-*Status object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exo_dnssec_verified_domain" "example" {
  domain = "contoso.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain the feature applies to. Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) The Get-*Status object for the domain, encoded as JSON; decode with jsondecode().
